**Current**
- Yahoo lists him as questionable (rest). (fact, 2026-10-16; stats)
- Orlando's projected starting center is Wendell Carter Jr. Vucevic is projected on the bench as the backup center. Goga Bitadze will still get some minutes. (fact, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/zhXtLr_xYVg?t=212), [10-13](https://youtu.be/zhXtLr_xYVg?t=1171), [08-26](https://youtu.be/sTtFUy7IoJI?t=1307), [08-26](https://youtu.be/sTtFUy7IoJI?t=1307), [09-22](https://youtu.be/QbdrhJd7LiA?t=1886), [10-08](https://youtu.be/WXO8MfQfzo0?t=2192), [08-24](https://youtu.be/g31YlwRe0XQ?t=2459), [08-01](https://youtu.be/FEcNjVRlj-U?t=366))
- Experts expect a reserve role of about 15 to 22 minutes, down from 28 last season. He could even end up third string. (verdict, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/zhXtLr_xYVg?t=1525), [10-10](https://youtu.be/hviT4hzYNME?t=1878), [08-26](https://youtu.be/sTtFUy7IoJI?t=1307), [08-01](https://youtu.be/FEcNjVRlj-U?t=366), [09-22](https://youtu.be/QbdrhJd7LiA?t=1886))
- Last season's numbers overrate him. His finish came from starting in Chicago, and his two-point scoring fell off a cliff in Boston, where he looked washed. (verdict, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/zhXtLr_xYVg?t=1472), [10-11](https://youtu.be/uI6umXsE7Vk?t=1891))
- He is a late swing pick around rounds 12 to 13. If he gets 23 to 25 minutes, he beats that draft spot. (verdict, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/zhXtLr_xYVg?t=1525), [10-11](https://youtu.be/uI6umXsE7Vk?t=1891), [10-10](https://youtu.be/hviT4hzYNME?t=1878), [10-08](https://youtu.be/WXO8MfQfzo0?t=2192), [09-15](https://youtu.be/KPdD91Oo8-U?t=2638))
- Sean Sweeney is Orlando's new head coach, so rotation roles may change. (fact, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/zhXtLr_xYVg?t=103), [08-01](https://youtu.be/FEcNjVRlj-U?t=359))
- Drafting him at a starter's price in the top 80 to 90 is a mistake. (verdict, 2026-09-22; [08-26](https://youtu.be/sTtFUy7IoJI?t=1344), [09-19](https://youtu.be/uarqbNA2dFk?t=2610), [09-22](https://youtu.be/QbdrhJd7LiA?t=1886))
- He has more upside if Wendell Carter Jr. gets hurt. In that case he could be top 100. (verdict, 2026-09-15, until Wendell Carter Jr. gets hurt; [09-15](https://youtu.be/KPdD91Oo8-U?t=2638), [08-24](https://youtu.be/g31YlwRe0XQ?t=2459))
- Orlando added him to fix its bench scoring, which ranked 27th or 28th last season. He can still score 12 to 14 points a game off the bench. (verdict, 2026-08-01; [08-01](https://youtu.be/FEcNjVRlj-U?t=397), [08-01](https://youtu.be/FEcNjVRlj-U?t=433))
- Some luck helped his assists. He converted 68% of potential assists. (verdict, 2026-07-17; [07-17](https://youtu.be/NYTH7uQsPCM?t=1746))
- He signed a minimum contract to return to Orlando as a backup. (fact, 2026-07-05; [07-05](https://youtu.be/4kKINkZhWls?t=418), [07-02](https://youtu.be/P6TNP-g0wzY?t=1807), [07-05](https://youtu.be/4kKINkZhWls?t=3135))

**Durable**
- He is 36 years old. (fact, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/zhXtLr_xYVg?t=1486))
- He shoots threes at decent volume for a big and is a good rebounder. (verdict, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/zhXtLr_xYVg?t=1486))
- He gets rebounds without blocks, and he never gets steals. Steals are his weakest category for a center. (verdict, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/zhXtLr_xYVg?t=1486), [07-15](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=750), stats)
- He is a poor defender. (verdict, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/zhXtLr_xYVg?t=1486), [07-02](https://youtu.be/P6TNP-g0wzY?t=1807))
- He is a pretty good passer for a big man. (verdict, 2026-07-17; [07-17](https://youtu.be/NYTH7uQsPCM?t=1746))

**Note.** Our league paid 17 USD for him last season. The market has dropped to about 1 USD (Yahoo 1.0, ESPN 1.3) now that he is Wendell Carter Jr.'s backup. Treat him as a 1 USD end-of-draft flyer and a Carter handcuff, not a starter: projections of 8.6 to 13.8 points depend on whether he gets about 25 minutes. He fits punt STL builds that want rebounds and some threes from a center. Early in the season, check his minutes against Carter and Bitadze under new coach Sweeney, and drop him fast if he stays near 15 to 20 minutes.
